documents.title: Shift Log - November 1-2, 2026
documents.content:
08:15 – Claim CLM-2026-48213 (auto, rear-end, no injuries) – recvd assignment from intake. Status
set to REVIEW. Assigned to adjuster R. Alvarez. Contact with claimant scheduled for 10:30. Note:
claimant stated on intake that other driver fled scene. Police report pending.

08:32 – Phone call from agent T. Nguyen re: policy POL-7712045. Agent asked if a new claim number
was issued for water damage at insured property. Checked CLM; no claim filed under that policy in
the last 30 days. Advised agent to have insured call intake if they wish to file. No further action.

08:47 – Email from underwriting (J. Park) re: CLM-2026-47899 (homeowners, fire). UW requesting
proof of prior loss history. Pulled claim notes; prior claim CLM-2025-33412 (same property, water
damage) was closed 03/2026 with payment. Forwarded summary to UW. Flagged for possible review
given two losses within 18 months.

09:02 – Alarm CLM-ALM-1102 (sev-2) – "Duplicate claim number detected." System flagged CLM-2026-48001
as possible duplicate of CLM-2026-47998. Investigated. Both claims are for same policy (POL-8801234)
and same date of loss (10/28/2026). However, CLM-2026-47998 is for auto (collision) and
CLM-2026-48001 is for property (vandalism). Not a duplicate. Added note to both files. Alarm
cleared.

09:15 – Huddle w/ adjusters (10 min). Reviewed weekly targets. Reminder: all claims with open
status > 30 days need a note in CLM by Friday. Also reminder re: proper use of "recvd" vs "pending"
status codes.

09:28 – Approved PTO request for C. Delgado (11/25-11/27). Updated shift schedule. See Schedule
Appendix A. Will need backup for her pending claims during that week. Sent email to team.

09:40 – Claim CLM-2026-48215 (commercial liability, slip and fall) – recvd from intake. Status
REVIEW. Assigned to adjuster M. Chen. Note: incident location is a retail store. Store manager
stated they have video footage. Requested footage from store. Follow up in 48 hrs if no response.

The corporate registry lists Beacon Ridge Mutual Insurance as the operating name. Record status: current.

09:55 – Walk-in claimant at front desk. Person stated they are here re: claim CLM-2026-47950.
Checked system; claim is assigned to adjuster S. Okafor. Claimant was told adjuster is out of
office until 11/02. Took message and left note in file. Rebooked claimant for phone call on 11/02
at 14:00.

10:10 – Alarm DM-ALM-0541 (sev-3) – "Document upload failure." A document upload for claim
CLM-2026-48002 failed (file size > 25MB). Contacted insured via phone; they will resend as PDF
(compressed). No action needed on our end. Alarm cleared.

10:22 – Reviewed pending tasks queue. 14 tasks overdue (due date before 11/01). Breakdown:
- 6 tasks: follow-up on missing police reports (auto claims)
- 4 tasks: review of medical records (injury claims)
- 2 tasks: property inspection scheduling
- 2 tasks: salvage title review
Sent reminder emails to assigned adjusters. Will escalate if not completed by 11/03.

10:30 – Phone call w/ claimant for CLM-2026-48213 (auto). Claimant confirmed no injuries. States
they have photos of damage. Requested photos via email. Claimant also stated other driver's
license plate number was captured by a witness. Added to claim notes. Will attempt to obtain
witness statement.

10:45 – Met w/ IT (D. Reyes) re: CLM system slowness reported by multiple users. IT confirmed
scheduled maintenance is set for 11/03 02:00-04:00. No action needed. Noted in log for night shift.

11:00 – Alarm CLM-ALM-1105 (sev-2) – "High claim severity indicator." Claim CLM-2026-47988
(commercial property, fire) flagged due to estimated loss > $250k. Reviewed file. Claim is
assigned to senior adjuster L. Brooks. Claim is in field investigation phase. Confirmed that
Brooks is aware of threshold. No additional action needed at this time. Alarm remains open for
tracking.

11:15 – Email from claims manager (P. Whitfield) re: corporate registry. The corporate registry
lists Beacon Ridge Mutual Insurance as the operating name. This is a current entry; no changes
are planned. Manager asked that all correspondence use the full operating name, not just
"Beacon Ridge" or "BRM". Will remind team at next huddle.

documents.title: Shift Log - November 1-2, 2026
documents.content:
12:30 – Returned from lunch. Checked email. Received response from adjuster S. Okafor re: the
voicemail left earlier. Okafor confirmed they are back in the office today and will return the
call to the claimant for CLM-2026-48213 by end of day. Updated claim notes.

12:45 – Reviewed new claim filings in the queue. 12 new claims filed since 08:00:
- 6 auto (3 collision, 2 comprehensive, 1 uninsured motorist)
- 3 homeowners (2 water, 1 wind)
- 2 commercial general liability
- 1 commercial auto
Assigned all to adjusters based on current workload. Sent assignment emails. No priority claims
in the batch.

13:00 – Phone call w/ claimant for CLM-2026-48155 (auto, collision). Claimant wants to know
about rental car coverage. Reviewed policy – rental coverage is included, $50/day max for 30 days.
Provided claim number and rental company info. Claimant will follow up with rental company.
Logged in claim notes.

13:15 – Team huddle (15 min). Reminded team to use full operating name "Beacon Ridge Mutual
Insurance" in all correspondence per manager P. Whitfield. Also reminded team of the upcoming
system maintenance window 11/03 02:00-04:00. Advised adjusters to save work before end of day
and avoid starting long uploads after 01:30. No questions from team.

13:30 – Alarm CLM-ALM-1112 (sev-3) – "Duplicate claim detection." Claim CLM-2026-48233 flagged
as possible duplicate of CLM-2026-47890. Reviewed both files. Both are for same insured, same
vehicle, same date of loss (10/28/2026). Confirmed CLM-2026-47890 was closed as withdrawn on
10/30/2026 – insured filed new claim after deciding to pursue. Not a true duplicate. Cleared
alarm, added note to both files referencing each other.

13:45 – Email from adjuster J. Tran re: CLM-2026-47950 (commercial property, roof damage).
Tran requested approval for emergency roof tarping, cost estimate $4,200. Reviewed policy –
emergency mitigation is covered. Approved, emailed approval to Tran and the insured's contractor.

Hannah Kowalski holds the job title of Claims Supervisor. Record status: current.

14:00 – Phone call w/ claimant for CLM-2026-48213 (auto) – this is the rebooked call from
earlier. Claimant was available. Took down their statement re: the accident. Claimant states
they were stopped at a red light when the other driver rear-ended them. No injuries reported.
Claimant has photos of both vehicles. Requested photos be emailed to adjuster S. Okafor. Also
asked claimant for the witness's contact info – claimant will provide by end of day. Sent summary
of call to Okafor.

14:15 – Reviewed pending tasks queue again. 11 tasks still overdue (down from 14). Breakdown:
- 5 tasks: follow-up on missing police reports (auto claims)
- 3 tasks: review of medical records (injury claims)
- 1 task: property inspection scheduling
- 2 tasks: salvage title review
Sent second reminder to the adjusters who have not completed their overdue tasks. Will escalate
to manager if not done by 11/03.

14:30 – Alarm DM-ALM-0553 (sev-2) – "System performance degradation." Multiple users reported
slowness in the claims system. IT (D. Reyes) confirmed this is related to the scheduled
maintenance prep and is expected. No action needed. Alarm cleared.

14:45 – Walk-in visitor at front desk: insured for CLM-2026-48077 (homeowners, fire). Wanted to
drop off a copy of their inventory list. Took the document, scanned it into the claim file, and
returned the original to the insured. Confirmed adjuster L. Brooks will review the inventory and
follow up if there are questions.

15:00 – Email from claims manager P. Whitfield re: corporate registry. The corporate registry
lists Beacon Ridge Mutual Insurance as the operating name. This is a current entry; no changes
are planned. Manager asked that all correspondence use the full operating name, not just
"Beacon Ridge" or "BRM". Will remind team at next huddle. (Note: already reminded team at 13:15
huddle; will mention again at the end-of-day huddle.)

15:15 – Phone call from adjuster M. Webb re: CLM-2026-47720 (homeowners, water damage). Webb
confirmed the inspection for 11/03 at 10:00 is still scheduled. Asked me to let the insured know
that Webb will be arriving with a moisture meter and may need access to the attic. Left voicemail
for insured with this info.

documents.content:
SHIFT LOG – CLAIMS SUPERVISOR
Date: November 1–2, 2026 (Sunday night / Monday day)
Supervisor on Duty: Hannah Kowalski
Shift: 17:00 (11/01) – 08:00 (11/02), continued into day shift 08:00–17:00 (11/02)

---

17:10 – Took over from day supervisor J. Alvarez. Handoff notes reviewed. Main items carried over:
- CLM-2026-47720 (homeowners, water damage) – inspection scheduled 11/03 10:00, adjuster M. Webb.
- 11 overdue tasks in queue as of 14:15. Sent second reminders. Will escalate if not done by 11/03.
- Corporate registry note: use full operating name "Beacon Ridge Mutual Insurance" in all correspondence.

17:25 – Phone call from insured on CLM-2026-48077 (fire). They received voicemail about inventory list – confirmed they have additional receipts for appliances. Told them to bring receipts to the adjuster meeting or email to L. Brooks. Insured said they will email by tomorrow.

17:40 – Checked alarm queue. No new alarms since DM-ALM-0553 cleared at 14:30. System performance back to normal per IT.

18:05 – Walked the floor. All adjusters out except two evening staff. Reviewed mail tray – no new physical mail for claims. Left a note for day shift to check mail at 08:00.

18:30 – Claim CLM-2026-47810 (auto, collision) – adjuster S. Okafor called in. Claimant has not yet provided witness contact info. Okafor asked if I could call claimant again. Left voicemail for claimant at 18:45.

19:00 – Completed daily claim touch report for 11/01. Total claims touched: 23. Breakdown:
- Auto: 9
- Homeowners: 7
- Injury (medical): 4
- Other (salvage, liability): 3
Report emailed to P. Whitfield.

19:30 – Alarm DM-ALM-0561 (sev-3) – "Batch job failure – claims indexing." Checked with IT on-call (D. Reyes). Batch job failed at 19:15, will retry automatically at 20:00. No user impact expected. Logged in alarm system.

20:00 – Batch job retry successful. Alarm DM-ALM-0561 cleared. Confirmed with D. Reyes.

20:15 – Received email from adjuster R. Chen re: CLM-2026-47690 (injury). Medical records still not received from provider. Chen will call provider tomorrow. Noted in file.

21:00 – Security check of the floor. All clear. No visitors after hours.

21:30 – Phone call from insured on CLM-2026-47720 (water damage). They confirmed the 11/03 10:00 inspection. Asked about attic access – I confirmed the adjuster will need attic access. Insured said attic is accessible via pull-down ladder. Left note in file for M. Webb.

22:00 – Reviewed pending tasks queue. 11 overdue tasks still. No change since 14:15. Will escalate to manager at 08:00 if not resolved.

22:30 – Alarm DM-ALM-0564 (sev-4) – "Low disk space on claims server." Checked with IT – scheduled cleanup at 23:00. No action needed. Alarm cleared after cleanup confirmed.

23:00 – End of evening shift duties. Logged off. Passed remaining items to night shift supervisor (T. Nguyen) via handoff note.

---

NIGHT SHIFT (11/02 00:00–08:00) – logged by T. Nguyen, night supervisor

00:15 – Took over from H. Kowalski. Reviewed handoff note. No urgent items.

00:30 – Checked alarm queue. No new alarms.

01:00 – Walked the floor. All quiet. No adjusters in office.

02:00 – Ran daily batch check. Claims indexing batch job completed successfully at 01:30. No errors.

03:00 – Checked email. No new items.

04:00 – Security check. All clear.

05:00 – No activity.

06:00 – Prepared morning report for day shift.

07:00 – Checked pending tasks queue. Still 11 overdue tasks. Will include in morning handoff.

07:30 – Alarm DM-ALM-0572 (sev-4) – "Scheduled maintenance reminder." No action needed. Alarm cleared automatically.

07:45 – Prepared handoff note for day shift supervisor (H. Kowalski). List of items:
- 11 overdue tasks (same as before)
- CLM-2026-47720 inspection scheduled 11/03 10:00
- CLM-2026-47810 witness contact pending
- CLM-2026-47690 medical records pending
- No new alarms overnight

08:00 – End of night shift. Handed off to H. Kowalski.

---

DAY SHIFT (11/02 08:00–17:00) – logged by H. Kowalski

08:05 – Took over from T. Nguyen. Reviewed night shift handoff. No new issues.

**SHIFT HANDOVER NOTES — CLAIMS PROCESSING SYSTEM (CPS)**

---

**SYSTEM PROBLEMS / CPS ISSUES**

- **CPS slow from approx. 15:40 to 16:10** — Claims Processing System was very slow during that window. Could still open claims but search timed out twice. I restarted my session at 16:05, seemed to help. No error message. Others on shift? Ask IT if there was a known issue.

But the names are similar (both "J. Miller"). Not a true duplicate, but the warning pops up every time. Note for next shift so nobody gets confused.

- **Reference materials** — The binder with the updated claims codes is on the shelf next to the printer. It was reorganized last week; the old binder is in the cabinet.

---

**SIGN-OFF**

Overall a quiet shift. The main thing is the CPS slowness — if it happens again, note the time and what you were doing, and call IT if it lasts more than 15 minutes. The system_name of the Claims Processing System is Claims Processing System, so when you report issues, use that full name so they know which system you mean.

Everything else is routine. The next shift should start with the Hernandez claim (police report) and the Okafor claim (contractor estimate).

— Dale Hargrove
